title: Marichiyadi Churna
description: Marichiyadi Churna (Marichadi Churna) is a black pepper-centered (Maricha) warming powder targeting the upper respiratory pathways for comprehensive nasal and sinus health. This classical formulation clears stubborn sinus blockages through warming and decongestant action. Dissolves thick phlegm in the throat through expectoration support. Treats chronic rhinitis (nasal inflammation) through anti-inflammatory action. Controls cold-induced fevers through immune support.
dosage: Mixed with honey or warm water
